owner: Baiyin Zitian Hongke Intelligent Computing Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Jingyuan County project filing lists a new internet data service / intelligent computing center at Baiyin Liuchuan Industrial Concentration Area, with 128 equipment sets, 140 cabinets at 12 kW each, 2,000P FP16 AI servers and supporting network, security, storage and AI software systems.
